accessibilityMode: keyboard only + prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (no screen reader)
objective: Reach a procedure, read it, step through the 3D stages and reach booking using only the keyboard.
device: Desktop Chrome descriptor (1366×768, mouse never used)
test: journeys\persona-e.spec.js › Persona E — keyboard and reduced motion

steps.expected: The first stop is a visible "Skip to content" link with a focus ring
steps.actual: focus: a.skip-link "Skip to content" ring=true inView=true

steps.action: Press Enter on the skip link
steps.expected: Focus moves to the main content

steps.action: Read headings and names from the accessibility tree
steps.expected: One h1; heading levels never skip; every button/link has a name
steps.actual: h1 count=1; 48 headings; level skips=0; unnamed buttons/links in snapshot=0; snapshot saved (17565 chars)

steps.expected: Focus visits wordmark → nav links → language → theme → Book, each with a visible ring, in visual order
steps.actual: skip-link:Skip to content → wordmark:Dr. Maan Al Barry Consultant Ophthalmolo → a:About → a:Procedures → a:Vision simulator → a:3D surgery → a:Patient education → a:Clinic & booking → icon-btn:التحويل إلى العربية → icon-btn:Light mode on. Switch to dark mode → btn:Book appointment; without visible ring: 0

steps.action: Keep tabbing to the cataract card's "Procedure details" link and press Enter
steps.expected: Cataract page opens; focus lands on the main heading area
steps.actual: reached after 8 tabs (0 stops without ring: ); now /en/procedures/cataract-surgery/ h1="Cataract surgery", focus main#main

steps.action: Tab to "Risks and possible complications" in the page contents and press Enter
steps.expected: Jumps instantly (reduced motion) to the risks section; text readable without the 3D
steps.actual: #p-risks top 81px after 60 ms (instant scroll); 4 risk items

steps.action: Tab to "Start the 3D experience" and press Enter
steps.expected: The 3D viewer loads and keyboard focus stays in a sensible place

steps.action: Check where keyboard focus is after the viewer opened
steps.expected: Focus is kept (start button) or moved into the viewer — never dropped to <body>
steps.actual: focus: div.csim-viewport "3D model of the eye. Drag to rotate, scr"

steps.action: Tab into the 3D viewer and use the arrow keys to change stage
steps.expected: ArrowRight → stage 2, ArrowRight → stage 3, ArrowLeft → stage 2; announced in the live region
steps.actual: Stage 2 of 7 → Stage 3 of 7 → Stage 2 of 7; live region: "Stage 2 of 7: Preparing and viewing the front of the eye"

steps.action: Press Space on the viewer to play, then Space to pause
Tab through every control in the viewer and out the other side
steps.expected: No keyboard trap: focus leaves the viewer; every stop has a visible ring
steps.actual: 26 stops inside the viewer, then left to proc-card-link:Procedure details: Lens implants (IOLs); stops without ring: none

steps.action: Shift+Tab back to "Back to site" (close) and press Enter
steps.expected: Viewer closes and focus returns to the Start button

steps.action: Keep tabbing to "Book appointment" in the closing band and press Enter
Switch to Arabic with the keyboard and check the skip link + drawer at 390 px
